summary: xAI released Grok Imagine Image 2.0, a new image generation and editing model available as the Quality Mode on Grok.com, mobile apps, and via the API as grok-imagine-image-2.0.

practices.reason: Image 2.0 offers stated gains in instruction-following precision and layout/typography fidelity for image generation and editing, backed by a public leaderboard ranking.
practices.quote: 2.0 follows instructions closely, down to the details. It plans typography and layout the way a designer would, so dense, multi-part visuals hold together and small text comes out sharp.

practices.reason: The model's quality claim is supported by a public Arena leaderboard ranking rather than a transferable in-house evaluation method.
practices.quote: It ranks second in the world in both text-to-image generation and image editing. Image Edit Arena Text-to-Image Arena Overall Elo. Source: Arena Image Edit and Text-to-Image leaderboards (as of Aug 7, 2026 ).

practices.reason: Teams building on the Grok Imagine API need to update to the new model identifier to access the upgraded capability.
practices.quote: Image 2.0 is available in the API as grok-imagine-image-2.0 .
